posts.text: ONE MORE HOUR! 🩷🔥 The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection drawing is almost closed, and this is your last call to get in on the action! Don't miss your chance to bring K/DA to the tabletop. Register before 9 AM PT TODAY! Sign up at: https://riot.com/3QYxPVC

Ever wonder what goes into bringing K/DA to the tabletop? Brice Cox, Creative Director of Riftbound, shares how the team brought the Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection to center stage and explores the creativity, artistry, and passion behind the stunning artwork with Fortiche! The Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection drawing…
The show continues at Nexus Night! Keep an eye out for the new alternate art cards in your #RBRadiance Nexus Night packs!

K/DA is ready to take the stage in your collection. Celebrate their comeback with the Riftbound x K/DA: Couture Collection, featuring cards with art by Fortiche, exclusive items inspired by K/DA, and the FIRESTARTER KIT! Sign up for the drawing before it closes: https://riot.com/3QYxPVC

The first-ever Riftbound Regional Championship: Europe kicks off next month in Stuttgart! Get ready for the region's biggest event yet with our Know Before You Go guide. Article: https://riot.com/4yHrXjD
